comments.content: Data race: Snapshot reads `len(c.n)` and ranges over `c.n` without holding `c.mu`, while Inc mutates the map under the lock. Per the story, GET /metrics is served while requests keep incrementing counters, so this concurrent map read/write can crash the process with 'fatal error: concurrent map iteration and map write' (unrecoverable) and violates the type's 'safe for concurrent use' contract. Take `c.mu.Lock(); defer c.mu.Unlock()` in Snapshot.
